_comment: ModelRouter v0 (TARGET-PLAN §3.2.1): the model registry and, per task class, the ordered backends to try. chat_voice, chat_text (typed turns, decision 21) and compact (decision 46) are bound in this build. debug_only entries exist in debug builds only. The router records the model the vendor reports serving, which can differ from the one asked for. context_window and max_output_tokens feed decision 46's context budget; xAI does not publish grok-voice-3.0's window, so the value is a conservative estimate. A realtime_voice entry may carry turn_detection per owner patience level (standard, long, extra_long: silence_duration_ms, prefix_padding_ms; decision 31, #247). grok-voice-3.0's values are PROVISIONAL starting points, not measured: the Phone B pause sweep (docs/runbooks/turn-detection-sweep.md) picks the finals and replaces them here. idle_timeout_ms is never sent.

turn_detection._comment: PROVISIONAL (#247): starting points only, not measured. The Phone B pause sweep picks the finals (docs/runbooks/turn-detection-sweep.md) and replaces these. Never add idle_timeout_ms.
